heading: Ọrụ ndị saịtị a nwere ike iji
withdrawn: Ewepụla nhọrọ niile. Ọrụ ọ bụla ga-ajụ ọzọ.
serviceSends_google_analytics: Na-agụ ọnụọgụ nleta na peeji ndị a gụrụ. Google na-enweta adreesị IP gị ma nwee ike ịtọ kuki.
serviceSends_youtube: Na-akpọ vidiyo site na YouTube. Google na-enweta adreesị IP gị ma nwee ike ịtọ kuki.
serviceSends_vimeo: Na-akpọ vidiyo site na Vimeo. Vimeo na-enweta adreesị IP gị; saịtị a na-arịọ ya ka ọ ghara ịchụso gị.
serviceSends_google_maps: Na-egosi maapụ site na Google Maps. Google na-enweta adreesị IP gị ma nwee ike ịtọ kuki.
serviceSends_speech: Mgbe ihe nchọgharị gị enweghị ike ịghọta okwu na ngwaọrụ gị, olu gị na-aga na ọrụ okwu ya (Google, Apple ma ọ bụ Microsoft).
serviceSends_github: Na-egosi kaadị ebe nchekwa na ọdịnaya ndị ọzọ site na GitHub. GitHub na-enweta adreesị IP gị ma nwee ike ịtọ kuki.
serviceSends_webstatus: Na-egosi baajị nkwado ihe nchọgharị Baseline site na webstatus.dev, ọrụ Google Chrome. Google na-enweta adreesị IP gị.
serviceSends_aframe: Na-ebunye ọba A-Frame site na aframe.io iji gosi ihe ngosi 3D. aframe.io na-enweta adreesị IP gị.
serviceSends_embed: Na-egosi ọdịnaya site na {host}. {host} na-enweta adreesị IP gị ma nwee ike ịtọ kuki.
